profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Hi, I’m Eric Markewitz, a Software Engineer specializing in cloud infrastructure and ETL data pipelines. I’m proficient in Java, Python, Javascript, Typescript, PHP, C#, C, and SQL, and working to expand my quiver by learning Go and Rust. I have experience developing responsive applications with modern component-based frameworks including React and React Native. Beyond languages and frameworks, I’m skilled in leading big data platforms and tools including AWS, Apache Airflow, Snowflake, Databricks, and Apache Spark. I hold a BS in Computer Science with a minor in Mathematics, providing a technical background in algorithms, data structures, artificial intelligence, and natural language processing, alongside my industry experience.
